demo.title: Demo
demo.description: See how the system works before creating an account.

about.title: About NosiFit
about.lead: Record your workouts, track recovery and see how your metrics change over time.

problem.title: What problem does NosiFit solve?
problem.text: Training is not only about exercises. It is important to see how workload affects sleep, energy and recovery. NosiFit brings basic records together and shows the connections between them, making workload decisions easier.

score.text: Recovery Score is a combined metric for a quick view of your recovery state. It helps you decide whether to plan a demanding workout or prioritize recovery.

audience.title: Who is it for?
audience.training: People who train regularly and want to see how workload affects their state.
audience.recovery: People who track sleep and recovery.
audience.data: People who like working with data and seeing changes over time.

info.title: What's in NosiFit
info.lead: A quick overview of the main features and how data becomes useful metrics.

actions.title: What you can do
actions.training: Record exercises, sets, repetitions and workload.
actions.sleep: Record sleep start and end times. NosiFit handles crossing midnight.
actions.habits: Track regular actions that affect recovery.
actions.recommendations: Get short recommendations based on your records.

dataFlow.title: How NosiFit uses data
dataFlow.dataText: workouts, sleep, nutrition, water and habits.
dataFlow.recommendationsText: short suggestions based on your current state.

purpose.title: Why use it?
purpose.text: NosiFit brings core training and recovery data together in one place. This helps you see the relationship between workload and your state and make simpler decisions.
